install_tell: OSS self-hostable (Go server + web dashboard) OR hosted SaaS at clawvisor.com. Self-host installer: curl -fsSL https://clawvisor.com/install.sh | sh. Default server.port=25297 binds 127.0.0.1; override to 0.0.0.0 for Cloud Run. SQLite local default; Postgres in prod (DATABASE_URL). Magic-link auth out of the box; admin@local seeded on first run. Vault backend local file ./vault.key or GCP KMS. Repo: github.com/clawvisor/clawvisor (221 stars 2026-06-07, Go, MIT-style).
misconfig_patterns: Self-host trap: docs explicitly warn that running the agent on the same host as Clawvisor allows the agent to bypass the gateway by reading the SQLite database or process environment directly. Operators who ignore the WARNING block sit the agent next to the daemon and lose the entire trust model.
callback.allow_private_cidrs is empty by default but accepts operator overrides. Adding overly-broad CIDRs (10.0.0.0/8) opens SSRF callback exposure to internal endpoints.
callback.require_https=false default. Production deployments accepting http:// callback URLs (except localhost) are vulnerable to callback hijacking on any tenant that does not set true.
vault.backend=local with vault.key sitting on disk next to clawvisor.db means database-disk compromise = full credential vault disclosure. Operators without backend=gcp on cloud deploys are exposed.
auth.max_users=0 (unlimited) by default. A self-hosted Clawvisor exposed on 0.0.0.0 with magic-link auth and no max_users cap can be enrolled into by any visitor with email access.
approval.on_timeout=fail is the safe default (300s) but operators flipping to 'skip' silently auto-approve any action whose human-in-the-loop timer expires.

response_markers: AI agent gatekeeper. Policy-based access control, credential vaulting, and human-in-the-loop approvals

active_probe.self_host_marker_25297: GET /health on port 25297 returns 200 with JSON body; X-Powered-By or Server header from Go net/http (no banner string). Web dashboard at / on 25297 serves the React/Vite SPA frontend_dir bundle.
active_probe.self_host_marker_api: GET /api/tasks returns 401 unauthorized when JWT absent; presence of /api/tasks AND /api/tasks/{id}/expand path pair anchors Clawvisor vs other policy gateways.

oauth_scope_manifest.discipline_note: READ, DO NOT EXERCISE. The scope set requested IS the finding. Names are the finding. Captured from internal/adapters/definitions/*.yaml (source-of-truth) and internal/adapters/google/*/adapter.go (Go scope constants).

google.workspace_marketplace_listing: not detected via passive scrape (Workspace Marketplace SPA hydrates client-side; either not listed or detection requires headless browser). Hosted deployments use customer's own Google Cloud project per docs/GOOGLE_OAUTH_SETUP.md, so per-customer OAuth consent screens rather than a single Marketplace listing.
google.sheets_scopes: (grep returned no match in google_sheets.yaml at fetch time; either inherits from drive scope or no Sheets adapter scope file shipped 2026-06-07)
google.scope_breadth_finding: Gmail.modify is requested by default. Per Google's scope-classification, gmail.modify is a RESTRICTED scope (CASA security assessment required for production verification). Operator running Clawvisor's hosted SaaS is on the hook for CASA; self-host deployments must complete their own Google Cloud OAuth consent screen with the same restricted-scope review.

microsoft.appsource_listing: not detected via passive scrape. Per microsoft credential.go architecture, OAuth flow is per-customer Azure AD app registration rather than AppSource publisher listing.
microsoft.scope_breadth_finding: Mail.Send + Calendars.ReadWrite + Files.ReadWrite combined under one consent is a wide-aperture grant. offline_access enables long-lived refresh tokens; if Clawvisor's vault.key is disclosed, refresh tokens permit attacker re-authentication until tenant admin revokes.

competitive_lane.lane: Lane C: Inbox Agent / Workspace addon middleware (Cat-33), with broader positioning as cross-service AI agent authorization gateway
competitive_lane.differentiator: Architecturally Clawvisor is NOT a Workspace addon (no Marketplace listing detected). It is a self-hostable / hosted policy gateway that sits between the agent and Google/Microsoft Graph APIs using per-customer OAuth consent. The brief's Lane C framing applies because the operative threat surface is the OAuth scope set requested from the customer's Workspace tenant, even though the integration shape is not the App Marketplace addon model.
